Show the GTAPViz MCP Server Settings

Source: R/mcp_install.R
mcp_config.Rd

Prints the settings that start the GTAPViz MCP server, ready to paste into any MCP-capable AI app. Use mcp_install() to write them automatically for Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor.

Usage

mcp_config(allow_r_code = FALSE, output_dir = NULL)

Arguments

allow_r_code

Logical. If TRUE, the AI may also run arbitrary R code in the GTAPViz session for custom data manipulation. Default FALSE.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Default folder for figures, tables and the session script. If NULL, outputs go next to the input data.

Value

Invisibly, a list with command and args.

See also

mcp_install(), mcp_serve()

Author

Pattawee Puangchit

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
mcp_config()
} # }
